generation.prompt: Use the exact No.9004 lavender/coral reference backpack, preserving logo, shape, colors, pockets and zippers. Entire closed bag on a light wood table beside a small sketchbook, pencils and plain pencil case; soft daylight, horizontal 3:2, no people or added text.

overlapReview: Reviewed all 35 titles, summaries and article bodies. New focus: dry drawing tools for a single sketch outing (not general day-trip packing); exterior identification of similar pouches (not sorting cables or reducing contents); parcel preparation for sending the bag itself (not long-term storage or the legacy packaging-development story). Three distinct models and images.
